# ROKLIM expands AI animation inspection to unchanged settings


By OpenTools Team


The update pairs a fuller view of node settings with named edits, variants and strength controls.


##


See the starting state


ROKLIM’s[October 30 changelog](https://roklim.com/changelog/) says its AI connector now exposes animation‑node settings that were left unchanged. That gives an editor’s AI a starting state to inspect before choosing a targeted adjustment.


##


Change a named control


The release lists changes by setting name, variant selection, strength adjustment and undo_last. ROKLIM asks claude.ai users to reconnect after updating. The connector predates this release; several published examples end in ellipses, leaving the page short of a complete parameter reference.


Original explanatory diagram: ROKLIM describes inspecting unchanged node settings and editing named controls; this is not its interface.
